value.name: install-github-workspace-key
command:
set -eu; mkdir -p /home/dsh/.ssh /home/dsh/workspace; cp /run/secrets/git-ssh/id_ed25519 /home/dsh/.ssh/id_ed25519; cp /run/secrets/git-ssh/known_hosts /home/dsh/.ssh/known_hosts; chmod 600 /home/dsh/.ssh/id_ed25519; chmod 644 /home/dsh/.ssh/known_hosts; printf 'Host github.com
  IdentityFile /home/dsh/.ssh/id_ed25519
  IdentitiesOnly yes
  StrictHostKeyChecking yes
  UserKnownHostsFile /home/dsh/.ssh/known_hosts
' > /home/dsh/.ssh/config; printf '[user]
  name = Konverta DSH
  email = dsh@konverta.eu
' > /home/dsh/.gitconfig; chmod 600 /home/dsh/.ssh/config /home/dsh/.gitconfig; chown -R 10001:10001 /home/dsh/.ssh /home/dsh/.gitconfig
